import pandas as pd
import seaborn as sns
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

# Load the dataset
data = pd.read_csv('data/credit_fraud.csv')

# Set the style for the visualization
sns.set(style="whitegrid")

# Create a bar plot showing the average transaction amount by hour of day and fraud status
plt.figure(figsize=(12, 6))
sns.barplot(data=data, x='hour_of_day', y='amount', hue='is_fraud', ci=None)

# Adding labels and title
plt.xlabel('Hour of Day')
plt.ylabel('Average Transaction Amount')
plt.title('Average Transaction Amount by Hour of Day and Fraud Status')
plt.legend(title='Is Fraud', loc='upper right', labels=['No Fraud', 'Fraud'])

# Save the figure
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
